Following a 12-hour barrage of missiles and drones, Kyiv authorities report 30 deaths. While air defenses intercepted most projectiles, several ballistic missiles struck residential areas, prompting a day of mourning.

The Bright Side:
Over 90% of incoming cruise missiles and drones were successfully intercepted by Ukrainian air defenses, preventing a much higher casualty count.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The error lies in the WHAT plane; the claim of 'military-industrial' targeting is contradicted by the physical reality of residential destruction.

Social Physics Analysis:
The regime uses the pretext of military retaliation to justify the destruction of civilian life. This projection of 'military necessity' onto residential targets is a classic high-strain, destructive configuration.

The Trajectory: The Path of Reckoning.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. The systemic strain of targeting civilians creates an unstable, high-entropy state.

The Unavoidable Truth: Residential areas were hit and civilians died.

The Unavoidable Lie: The attack was limited to military-industrial facilities.
